subject: general
question: Spicejet recently operated India's first ever biojet fuel flight. Which of the following institutes prepared the fuel?

options.text: Defence Research and Development Organization, New delhi

solution:
The correct answer is __**CSIR-Indian Institute of Petroleum (IIP), Dehradun**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Spicejet recently operated India's first ever biojet fuel flight.
 
• The fuel for this flight was prepared by **CSIR-Indian Institute of Petroleum (IIP), Dehradun**.
